title: Dark Legend
lines: The overall strength of the Dark Legend makes it slightly stronger than the much sought after Black Widow Limited.
This 500/1000 Abralon TM finish is polished with our Powerhouse Clean & Sheen polish which provides moderate length on medium to oily lane conditions.
Our legendary Gas Mask Core creates a strong overall ball motion that never quits.
FACTORY FINISH 500 / 1000 Abralon® Polished w/Powerhouse Clean N’ Sheen
BEST LANE CONDITION Medium to Heavy Oil
